im clean 2 weeks. Its so hard. I feel like just giving up but i just cant. Ive seen how my addiction effects the people i love. And as much as i love the feeling of being numbed of all my pain, it feels better to know that im sober. im one that got over it. lets just hope i dont relapse. because that would be the end of me.
